question: Which LLTO coating retained the most capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5C, how does it compare with the pristine NCM, and why did the 2 mol.% coating lower the rate capability?
rendered:
According to Table 4, LLTO-1 coating retained about 85.5% of its initial discharge capacity after 200 cycles, which is more than LLTO-2 (86.2%) and LLTO-0.5 (85.2%) (not mentioned, but it can be inferred that it is more than LLTO-2). The pristine NCM only retained 56.6% of its initial discharge capacity after 200 cycles.

The 2 mol.% coating lowered the rate capability, which may be due to the increase in the thickness of the coating layer, resulting in the suppression of electron transfer process during charge/discharge cycling.
